About

works at the intersection of AI infrastructure, inference, and applied intelligence. Content is a core growth lever for us, not a support function.

Role Overview

This is a growth-focused content role for someone who wants to move beyond pure content writing into content strategy and marketing. You will start by owning execution across blogs, documentation, and website copy, and gradually take on responsibility for planning, positioning, and growth-driven content decisions.

You will work closely with product, engineering, and marketing to gain a deep understanding of the product and translate that understanding into content that drives adoption, builds trust, and supports long-term growth.

Key Responsibilities

Content Execution

  • Write and maintain high-quality product documentation and guides

  • Write blog posts focused on AI Models, inference, performance, and product use cases

  • Update and improve website copy, including landing pages, feature pages, and product descriptions

  • Create walkthrough videos of our products and other related AI tools

  • Ensure content is clear, accurate, and aligned with the product narrative

Content Planning and Growth

  • Create and manage a structured content calendar aligned with growth goals

  • Identify opportunities where content can drive user acquisition, activation, and education

  • Learn how content contributes to funnels, conversion, and product adoption

  • Evolve from executing content to shaping content direction and priorities

Strategy and Internal Tools

  • Utilize internal tools to research topics, plan content, and build a content strategy

  • Use internal data, feedback, and tools to improve content quality and effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to translate complex technical ideas into simple, compelling stories

Who This Role Is For

  • Someone strong at writing who wants to grow into content strategy and marketing

  • A self-starter interested in how content drives business and product growth

  • Someone curious about AI, SaaS, and developer-focused products

  • A person who wants ownership, learning, and long-term growth rather than just task-based writing

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong writing and editing skills with attention to clarity and structure

  • Experience creating and maintaining content calendars

  • Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them simply

  • Experience updating and optimizing website copy

  • Comfort working with internal tools, CMS platforms, and content workflows

Nice to Have

  • Experience in AI, SaaS, or developer-first products

  • Exposure to SEO, content performance metrics, or growth funnels

  • Experience writing product documentation or technical blogs

Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Content Marketing Manager – Industrial B2B

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors and thrives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. This individual will create content that earns the trust of executive audiences and translates complex technical concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption.

You'll develop category-defining content including SME-driven insights, research-backed reports, practitioner guides, webinars, and executive thought leadership. The ideal candidate is curious, resourceful, process-oriented, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Content

• Manage content creation across blogs, articles, long-form content, video scripts, webinars, and social media assets aligned to product capabilities, use cases, audience segments, and pipeline goals.

• Develop and oversee the production of how-to guides, research reports, solution briefs, white papers, and other high-value content assets.

• Manage relationships with freelance writers, agencies, and external contributors, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to brand standards.

• Develop executive thought leadership programs, including ghostwriting, podcast preparation, speaking opportunities, and bylined articles for industry publications.

• Create content that resonates with industrial decision-makers, including VP-level leaders in Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations.

• Partner with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and other cross-functional teams to translate positioning and messaging into always-on content programs spanning the full buyer journey.

• Collaborate with subject matter experts, customers, product managers, developers, and data scientists to create accurate, credible, and practitioner-focused content.

• Identify content opportunities and gaps through search intent analysis, competitive research, analyst insights, and feedback from sales and customer-facing teams.

• Drive content repurposing strategies to maximize the reach, impact, and lifecycle of high-performing content across channels and formats.

SEO & Distribution

• Support organic content strategy through keyword research, topic clustering, content planning, and on-page SEO optimization.

• Focus on high-intent, bottom-of-funnel content opportunities that drive qualified traffic and business outcomes.

• Partner with Demand Generation teams to integrate content into nurture programs, paid campaigns, and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives.

• Manage content distribution across owned channels, including blogs, newsletters, and developer communities, as well as earned channels such as syndication, guest publications, and industry forums.

• Ensure content is optimized for discoverability across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered search and answer platforms.

Measurement & Optimization

• Track and report on key content performance metrics, including organic traffic, engagement, MQL contribution, pipeline influence, and content-attributed revenue.

• Conduct regular content audits to identify opportunities for content refreshes, consolidation, optimization, and removal of underperforming assets.

• Test and optimize headlines, calls-to-action (CTAs), content formats, and distribution strategies using data-driven insights.

• Leverage performance analytics to continuously improve content effectiveness and scale successful initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of B2B content marketing experience, including at least 2 years focused on industrial or engineering-driven audiences.

• Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex technical topics for executive and business audiences.

• Demonstrated success translating highly technical concepts such as data pipelines, cloud architecture, observability, security, and enterprise technology into compelling narratives.

• Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals and experience driving measurable organic growth.

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and deliver high-quality content on schedule.

• Familiarity with modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and concepts such as data lakehouses.

• Understanding of industrial software, manufacturing technology, engineering technology, or related enterprise software markets.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience marketing to developers, practitioners, engineers, or other highly technical audiences at scale.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, Ahrefs, SEMrush, WordPress, or similar marketing technology platforms.

• Portfolio demonstrating technical content creation, including long-form guides, white papers, executive thought leadership, and industry publications.

• Strong process orientation with experience building and improving content workflows and operational processes.

• Experience leveraging AI-powered writing, research, and workflow automation tools to improve productivity and content effectiveness.

Closing:

    U.S. Pay Transparency Statement

    The base salary range for this position is $102,500 - $184,500 USD. Individual compensation will vary based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Siemens also offers a comprehensive benefits package and may provide additional incentive compensation where applicable.

About CoVet

CoVet is an AI copilot application built to assist veterinary professionals by saving them time and allowing them to focus more on animal care—or even get home on time. We are a small, passionate, and agile team with a strong mission to improve the veterinary industry through innovative technology.

About the role

CoVet is an AI-powered clinical co-pilot built by veterinary professionals, for veterinary professionals. We help clinics reduce administrative burden, improve communication, and reclaim time for patient care. As we expand internationally, content plays a critical role in how we educate markets, build trust, support sales, and strengthen our position with veterinary professionals, partners, and media.

What you'll do

  • We are hiring a Content Marketing Manager, Europe to help accelerate growth across key European markets, with a primary focus on German-speaking regions and secondary focus across the Nordics and select adjacent markets. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a multilingual content marketer who can combine strong writing and localization skills with commercial awareness, media relationship-building, and a sharp understanding of SEO-driven growth.
  • You will be responsible for creating and localizing high-quality content that supports market expansion, demand generation, partner activity, and brand credibility. You will work across a wide range of formats, from SEO content and comparison pages to case studies, webinars, presentations, PR materials, and media opportunities. You will also help support affiliate, influencer, and media relationships in your markets, while working closely with internal teams across sales, enterprise, partnerships, support, and product-adjacent functions.
  • This role is ideal for someone who has done a bit of everything across content: editorial, SEO, campaigns, distribution, localization, and relationship-led content development. Video production experience is a strong asset, as is familiarity with social content, but this role is primarily for a commercially minded content marketer with strong execution ability.
  • You will own and support content strategy and production for priority European markets.
  • You will create and adapt content across multiple formats, including:
    • SEO-driven website content
    • blog and educational content
    • comparison and solution pages
    • journal-style and thought leadership articles
    • customer stories and case studies
    • webinar and podcast support materials
    • presentation content for events, partnerships, and sales enablement
    • PR and media-facing content
    • social and campaign support content
    • localized in-app messaging, notifications, and email support where needed
  • You will work closely with regional sales and business development teams to ensure content supports pipeline development, market education, and local credibility.
  • You will help identify and build relationships with relevant media, affiliate, influencer, PR, and distribution partners in your regions, and support content opportunities that improve CoVet’s visibility and market trust.
  • You will collaborate with the wider marketing team to align European content with brand standards, campaign priorities, product releases, and commercial goals.
  • You will support localization across priority materials, balancing speed with quality and making sure content feels relevant and credible in-market rather than directly translated.
  • You will work with the broader content function to ensure consistency across messaging, while also helping the business move faster in Europe through better local execution.

Cross-functional collaboration

This role will work closely with:

  • Sales and Enterprise: to support account conversations, regional messaging, sales enablement, and local market opportunities
  • Partnerships: to build co-marketing assets, partner-facing materials, and market-specific campaigns
  • Support and Customer teams: to create educational and onboarding-adjacent content where needed
  • Design and Creative: to develop visual assets, campaign materials, presentations, and media-ready content
  • PR, media, affiliates, and influencers: to expand reach and improve market relevance
  • Other content team members: to coordinate calendars, share knowledge, and maintain consistency across regions and channels

What success looks like

In this role, success means increasing the speed, quality, and consistency of CoVet’s content presence in Europe. It means helping the company show up more credibly in local markets, supporting commercial teams with better-localized assets, building stronger media and partner visibility, and improving content quality across the funnel.

You should expect to be measured on a mix of output, quality, responsiveness, market relevance, and commercial impact.

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • multilingual, ideally with strong German fluency
  • an experienced content marketer with broad hands-on experience across multiple formats and channels
  • strong in SEO and comfortable building content that supports organic growth
  • a strong writer and editor with the ability to adapt tone and message by audience and market
  • comfortable working across both strategic planning and execution
  • experienced in collaborating with external partners such as media, affiliates, PR contacts, or influencers
  • commercially aware and able to connect content to pipeline, adoption, and market development
  • organized, self-directed, and comfortable working across multiple priorities and stakeholders

Preferred experience

  • experience working across DACH markets
  • familiarity with Nordic markets
  • background in B2B SaaS, healthtech, medtech, AI, or another complex product category
  • video production or video content planning experience
  • exposure to social content and distribution strategy
  • experience supporting localized content for applications, lifecycle comms, or product messaging

Why this role matters

This role helps CoVet deepen its position in Europe by improving how we educate the market, support sales, work with partners, and build trust. It is a key part of turning expansion ambition into repeatable in-market execution.

Why Join Us?

  • Work in a fast-paced startup environment where your work has a direct impact.
  • Flexible working arrangements and growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements.

Syntropic Scribe

Kalungi is hiring a Syntropy Scribe.

This is a senior content strategist and writer role, but at Kalungi, the work doesn’t start with writing.

As a Kalungi Scribe, work begins with people, not keywords. We extract insight from founders, customers, and the market, then turn that insight into clear narratives and high-impact content for B2B SaaS GTM.

We don’t start from briefs or prompts; we start from interviews, research, and pattern recognition. SEO-friendly and high-converting content that ranks is the result of our Scribe work.

We use AI because it can help with drafting and speed, but AI can’t decide what matters. That’s our job.

What you’ll do

1. Extract human signal

  • Run interviews with founders, customers, sales teams, and subject-matter experts
  • Mine calls, transcripts, win/loss notes, and field conversations for non-obvious insights
  • Identify patterns, tensions, and language buyers actually use, not what tools infer

2. Turn insight into narrative and positioning

  • Translate raw signal into clear positioning, messaging, and POVs for B2B SaaS companies
  • Create messaging and positioning guides teams can use across marketing and sales
  • Partner with the Syntropy Navigator (CMO) to ensure narrative clarity drives GTM strategy

3. Write and shape high-impact content

  • Website copy (core pages, positioning, use cases)
  • Long-form content like webinars, lead magnets, guides, and narrative-driven reports
  • Blog content grounded in original insight, not recycled opinion
  • Ad copy and landing page copy that reflects real buyer language
  • Founder and customer stories
  • Social and distribution content that carries signal, not fluff

4. Repurpose with intent

  • Turn interviews, webinars, and long-form assets into cohesive content systems
  • Repurpose insight across blogs, social, email, and sales enablement — without diluting the core narrative
  • Ensure every derivative asset reinforces the same story

5. Use AI to accelerate, not replace, thinking

  • Use AI tools to support research, synthesis, drafting, and repurposing
  • Set up prompts, workflows, and content libraries that speed up production while preserving voice and signal
  • Act as the editor-in-chief: refining, correcting, and deciding what should not be automated.

What this role is not

This role is not:

  • A keyword-first SEO content role
  • A blog factory or content ops position
  • Prompt-only AI writing or ghostwriting
  • A volume or velocity output function

What we’re looking for

You likely have experience in content strategy, writing, journalism, research, product marketing, or strategy, ideally in B2B SaaS.

You are:

  • A strong interviewer who knows how to ask the question behind the question
  • A sharp synthesizer who can turn complexity into simple, precise language
  • A confident writer who values clarity over cleverness
  • Comfortable shaping messaging, positioning, and narrative, not just executing briefs
  • Fluent enough in B2B SaaS to recognize real signal versus surface-level noise
  • Experienced using AI tools as support, without outsourcing judgment to them

We care more about how you think than the tools you’ve used.

How you’ll know you’re succeeding

You’re winning when:

  • Founders and clients say, “That’s exactly what we’re seeing, we just hadn’t named it.”
  • Messaging and positioning become clearer and more consistent across channels
  • Content performs better because it’s grounded in real insight, not tactics
  • Sales, marketing, and leadership pull from the same narrative source of truth
  • AI-assisted content improves because the underlying thinking is strong

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

Safeguard Global is seeking a highly organized, execution-focused, and AI-forward Content Manager to lead content planning, writing, production, and delivery across our global marketing organization.



Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, this individual will own the content calendar and drive the execution of a high-volume content strategy that supports demand generation, brand awareness, sales enablement, and pipeline growth. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires balancing strategic planning with rapid execution across a wide range of content formats, including blogs, webinars, social media posts, white papers, email campaigns, sales collateral, competitive intelligence sheets, and more.



The Content Manager will lead and develop a team of three content professionals, ensuring the team operates efficiently, meets aggressive deadlines, and consistently delivers high-quality, impactful content. The ideal candidate brings experience in the HR industry, proven people management capabilities, exceptional project management skills, and a forward-thinking approach to leveraging AI to accelerate content production and improve team productivity.

This role is built for a content leader who thrives on volume, speed, quality, and measurable impact.



Key Responsibilities



Content Strategy, Planning & Execution

  • Own and manage the integrated content calendar, aligning priorities, timelines, and deliverables with demand generation campaigns, product marketing initiatives, sales priorities, and broader business objectives.
  • Drive the end-to-end execution of a high-volume content production engine across multiple channels, formats, audiences, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Oversee the development and delivery of blogs, social media content, thought leadership, white papers, webinars, email campaigns, sales collateral, competitive battlecards, case studies, and other marketing assets.
  • Translate campaign briefs, business priorities, product messaging, and market insights into clear content plans and actionable deliverables.
  • Establish repeatable workflows, production processes, and editorial standards that enable the team to scale content output without sacrificing quality.
  • Balance competing requests and shifting priorities while maintaining visibility into production status, dependencies, and delivery timelines.

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of three content professionals based in LATAM, providing clear direction, prioritization, feedback, and accountability.
  • Distribute work effectively across the team based on capacity, skills, timelines, and business impact.
  • Set clear expectations for output, quality, turnaround times, and individual performance.
  • Build a collaborative, high-accountability team culture focused on execution, continuous improvement, and meeting ambitious goals.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team capacity and performance through better processes, skills development, resource allocation, and technology.

AI-Forward Content Production

  • Champion the practical and responsible use of AI tools throughout the content lifecycle to increase productivity, accelerate turnaround times, and expand content output.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows for research, ideation, outlining, drafting, editing, repurposing, localization, and content optimization.
  • Equip the team with effective AI tools, prompts, templates, and repeatable workflows that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content into multiple formats and channels, maximizing the value of every content investment.
  • Maintain strong editorial judgment and quality standards, ensuring AI-assisted content is accurate, differentiated, on-brand, and aligned with Safeguard Global's expertise and messaging.
  • Continuously test and adopt emerging AI capabilities that can improve content operations and team efficiency.

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Partner closely with the Director of Demand Generation to ensure content priorities support campaign objectives, audience engagement, lead generation, and pipeline growth.
  • Collaborate with demand generation, product marketing, sales, brand, communications, and subject matter experts to deliver relevant, timely content.
  • Develop sales enablement assets, including competitive comparison sheets, battlecards, objection-handling materials, presentations, and customer-facing collateral.
  • Ensure content is tailored to target audiences, buyer personas, industry needs, and stages of the customer journey.
  • Support content distribution and repurposing strategies that extend reach, improve engagement, and maximize campaign performance.
  • Incorporate feedback and performance insights into future content planning and production.

Operational Excellence & Measurement

  • Establish clear processes for intake, briefing, prioritization, review, approvals, and publishing.
  • Track content production volume, on-time delivery, turnaround times, team capacity, and quality.
  • Monitor content performance in partnership with demand generation and use insights to inform future priorities.
  • Proactively identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and resolve issues that could impact delivery.
  • Communicate progress, risks, resource needs, and results to marketing leadership.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing, content strategy, editorial operations, or a related marketing discipline.
  • Experience in the HR industry is required, ideally within HR technology, HCM, payroll, benefits, talent management, workforce management, employer services, or related B2B solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing a team, including setting priorities, delegating work, coaching employees, and driving accountability.
  • Proven ability to manage high-volume content production and consistently deliver against aggressive deadlines.
  • Experience producing and managing a broad range of B2B marketing content, including long-form and short-form assets, campaign content, and sales enablement materials.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve content production, team productivity, workflow efficiency, and content repurposing.
  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and editorial judgment, with the ability to maintain quality and consistency at scale.
  • Experience collaborating with demand generation and sales teams to support campaign execution and business objectives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work across functions, time zones, and geographies.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment where priorities evolve and execution speed matters.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a global or distributed marketing organization.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation, content management systems, project management platforms, and digital marketing analytics.
  • Experience developing content for international audiences and coordinating localization or regional adaptation.
  • Understanding of SEO, content distribution, conversion-focused messaging, and demand generation best practices.
  • Experience building scalable content operations and introducing AI-enabled processes within a marketing team.
  • Professional fluency in English; additional language capabilities relevant to LATAM markets are a plus.

Success Measures


Success in this role will be measured by the individual's ability to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing content operation.


Key indicators include:

  • Content output: Consistently delivering the volume and mix of content required to support marketing and business priorities.
  • On-time execution: Meeting aggressive deadlines and maintaining a reliable, visible content calendar.
  • Content quality: Producing accurate, compelling, differentiated content aligned with brand standards and business messaging.
  • Team performance: Building a productive, accountable, and continuously improving team.
  • AI-driven efficiency: Demonstrating measurable improvements in production speed, team capacity, and workflow efficiency through AI adoption.
  • Demand generation impact: Supporting campaign execution, audience engagement, lead generation, and sales enablement through relevant content.
  • Operational scalability: Establishing processes that enable Safeguard Global to increase content output while maintaining quality and efficiency.

The Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a hands-on content leader who knows how to turn ambitious marketing priorities into an organized, high-output production engine. They are comfortable managing people, juggling multiple deadlines, and making smart trade-offs without losing sight of quality or business impact.



They understand the HR landscape, know how to create content that resonates with business audiences, and actively embrace AI as a way to help their team work smarter and faster. They combine strong editorial instincts with operational discipline, lead by example, and take ownership of getting the right content delivered at the right time.



At Safeguard Global, this is an opportunity to build and scale a modern, AI-enabled content function that directly supports global marketing and demand generation growth.
